Nirutti. 539-nhā. Yugaṃ dhārayatīti yugantaro. Nirutti. 539-nhā. Yugaṃ dhārayatīti yugantaro. Kappadduma. Yuganjara-saṃ. Yugaṃdhara-prā] Mount Yugandhiura, which is one of a mountain among seven mountain range which are (surrounded) the Mount  mraṅaḥmiura. See original. Yugandhara(pu) [yugandhara+ṇa] King (ogre) who lived in Yugandhiura mountain. Yugandhara(pu) [yuga+dhara+a.yugandhara+(kana)ka. Ru. 234-nhā.] Sabbaññuta wisdom(Omniscience of the Buddha) which likes Yugandhiura mountain.  Sabbaññuta wisdom(Omniscience of the Buddha) which can be taken/known Pair which is the sequence of self-body and the sequence of other body. Yugandhara(pu) [yuga+dhara+a. Yugaṃdhāretīti yugandharo, saññāyaṃ a. Abhidhānārasso. Dhāna, ṭī. 374.] Coach set , Cart set (such as body and wheel, yoke etc., A Coach which is driven by horses (or) oxes. (Dhāna, syha. Saca. 374). A place where is front portion of a cart, A place of a Coach where shaft and yoke intersect.
pn:
Yugandhara 01. One of the mountains of the Himālaya (Ja.i.119, 232; iv.213; vi.125; Dhp-a.i.249; Vsm.206). It forms the first of the seven ranges round Sineru (Snp-a, ii.443; but according to Ja.vi.125 it is the fourth range).

A Yugandharasāgara (e.g., Ja.i.64; vi.43) is also sometimes mentioned, and was probably a sea between Yugandhara and the next mountain range. When the Buddha reached Tāvatiṁsa in three strides, his first stride was from the earth to Yugandhara (Dhp-a.iii.216). It was on the summit of Yugandhara that Assagutta convened an assembly of the monks in order to discuss their plan of campaign against Milinda (Mil.p.6). The sun is mentioned as first rising over Yugandhara (e.g., SN-a.ii.165), hence the expression “Like the morning sun over Yugandhara”, e.g. Pv-a.137.
Yugandhara 02. One of the chief Yakkhas to be invoked by the Buddha’s followers in time of need. DN.iii.205
a: စန္ဒသူရိယ-သင်္ခါတံ ယုဂံ ဓာရေတီတိ တဒုဗ္ဗေဓမ္မဂ္ဂစာရိတ္တာတိ ယုဂန္ဓရော။ ဓာန်၊ ဋီ။ ၂၆။ အဋ္ဌသာ၊ ယော။ ၃။ ယုဂံ ရဝိန္ဒဒွယံ ဓာရေတီတိ ယှဂန္တရော။ နိရုတ္တိ။ ၅၃၉-နှာ။ ယုဂံ ဓာရယတီတိ ယုဂန္တရော။ နိရုတ္တိ။ ၅၃၉-နှာ။ ယုဂံ ဓာရယတီတိ ယုဂန္တရော။ ကပ္ပဒ္ဒုမ။ ယုဂန္ဇရ-သံ။ ယုဂံဓရ-ပြာ] ယုဂန္ဓိုရ်တောင်၊ မြင်းမိုရ်တောင်ကို ဝန်း(ဝိုင်း)ရံ၍ တည်သော တောင်စဉ် ၇-ထပ်တို့တွင် တစ်ခုသော တောင်။ မူရင်းကြည့်ပါ။ yugandhara ယုဂန္ဓရ(ပု) [ယုဂန္ဓရ+ဏ] ယုဂန္ဓိုရ်တောင်၌နေသောနတ်(ဘီလူး)မင်း၊ ယုဂန္ဓိုရ်နတ်(ဘီလူး)မင်း။ yugandhara ယုဂန္ဓရ(ပု) [ယုဂ+ဓရ+အ။ယုဂန္ဓရ+(ကန်)က။ ရု။ ၂၃၎-နှာ။] ယုဂန္ဓိုရ်တောင်နှင့်တူသော သဗ္ဗညုတဉာဏ်။ မိမိခန္ဓာအစဉ် သူတစ်ပါးခန္ဓာ အစဉ်ဟု ဆိုအပ်သော အစုံကို ဆောင်တတ်သော သဗ္ဗညုတဉာဏ်။ yugandhara ယုဂန္ဓရ(ပု) [ယုဂ+ဓရ+အ။ ယုဂံဓာရေတီတိ ယုဂန္ဓရော၊ သညာယံ အ။ အဘိဓာနာရဿော။ ဓာန်၊ ဋီ။ ၃၇၎။] ရထား-လှည်း-အုပ်ဆုံ၊ ရထားမြင်း-နွား-က ရာအရပ်(ဓာန်၊ သျှ။ သစ်။ ၃၇၎)။လှည်းဦးဆုံ၊ ရထား၌ နွားမြင်းပခုံးထမ်းရာ-ထမ်းပိုးခွင်-အရပ်။

pn: Yudhiṭṭhila 01. Son of the Paṇḍu king and one of the five husbands of Kaṇhā. Ja.v.424, 426.
Yudhiṭṭhila 02. Son of Sabbadatta, king of Ramma, and younger brother of the Bodhisatta, born as Yuvañjaya. He is identified with Ānanda. See the Yuvañjayajātaka.

Yudhiṭṭhila 03. The name of a gotta to which Dhanañjaya, king of the Kurus, belonged (Ja.iii.400; v. 59, etc.). Mention is made also of a Koravyarājā of the Yudhiṭṭhila gotta (Ja.iv.361).
